text: On Aug. 4, the PBOC Guangdong branch held its H2 2026 work meeting and Guangdong foreign-exchange management meeting, directing continuation of a moderately loose monetary policy to help stabilise Guangdong growth and calling for stronger support to priority sectors and weak link
text_zh: 8月4日，中国人民银行广东省分行召开2026年下半年工作会议和广东省外汇管理工作会议，指示继续实施适度宽松的货币政策，以助力稳定广东增长，并要求加强对重点领域和薄弱环节的支持。
